attestations.text: Chang Kêng 張賡 (T. 明臯, H. a native of Chin-chiang, Fukien, who was baptized in 1621 under the name Matthew), a work entitled 聖教信證 Shêng-chiao hsin-chêng ("Proofs of the Christian Religion"), which has a preface dated 1647 and was printed in Peking in 1668 and 1674.
